kill_switch.comment: OFF by default. TCP transport is no-op until explicitly enabled. Per-node enforcement stays in WFP kernel driver.

server_side.comment: bind_addr port 0 = OS-assigned ephemeral (useful for tests). Production: fixed port like 7931.

client_side.comment: Remote address to connect to. Empty = client mode disabled (server-only).

socket_timeouts_ms.comment: Blocking sockets with SO_RCVTIMEO/SO_SNDTIMEO. recv returns Timeout (WouldBlock) instead of hanging forever.

socket_options.comment: TCP_NODELAY disables Nagle for low-latency federation messages. SO_REUSEADDR allows quick rebind after restart.

reconnect.comment: Exponential backoff on connect failure. After max_attempts, gives up (caller can reset).

frame_protocol.comment: TCP is a byte stream, not a message stream. FramedReader reassembles 12-byte header + payload from arbitrary recv chunks.

error_handling.not_connected: send/recv attempted before connect or after disconnect
error_handling.comment: Errors propagate as TransportError; FederationFacade (Phase 39 Ext 1) handles reconnect via ConnectionManager.
